core/stratagems/Command Re-roll/effect:
That roll re-rolled
If several dice rolled together: one of those dice selected for the re-roll
Exception: Charge roll re-rolled in full
core/stratagems/Command Re-roll/when:
Any phase
Just after you make a roll for a friendly unit or model, one of:
- Advance roll
- Charge roll
- Damage roll
- Hazard roll
- Hit roll
- Save roll
- Wound roll
- roll setting how many attacks a weapon generates
core/stratagems/Counteroffensive/effect:
Own unit: Fights First gained
Own unit must be the next unit you select to fight (12.04)
until end of phase
core/stratagems/Counteroffensive/when:
Fight step of your opponent's Fight phase
Just after an enemy unit finishes resolving its attacks
core/stratagems/Crushing Impact/effect:
1. Enemy unit engaged with own unit selected
2. Model in own unit engaged with that enemy unit selected
3. D6 rolled, one per point of that model's T characteristic:
- each 1: own unit suffers 1 mortal wound
- each 5+: that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound
- maximum 6 mortal wounds per unit
core/stratagems/Crushing Impact/when:
Your Charge phase
Just after a friendly MONSTER/VEHICLE unit ends a charge move
core/stratagems/Epic Challenge/effect:
CHARACTER model in own unit selected
Its melee weapons: [PRECISION] gained
until end of phase
core/stratagems/Epic Challenge/when:
Fight phase
Just after a friendly CHARACTER unit is selected to fight
core/stratagems/Explosives/effect:
1. Own unit: 1 EXPLOSIVES/GRENADES model selected
2. 1 enemy unit selected: unengaged, ≤8" from that model, visible to it
3. 6D6 rolled: 1 mortal wound inflicted on selected enemy unit per 4+ (06.02)
core/stratagems/Explosives/target:
Friendly unengaged EXPLOSIVES/GRENADES unit
Eligible to shoot
No advance move made this turn
core/stratagems/Fire Overwatch/target:
Friendly unengaged unit
TITANIC units excluded
core/stratagems/Fire Overwatch/when: End of your opponent's Movement phase
core/stratagems/Heroic Intervention/effe:
Own unit: charge resolved (11.02)
During charge resolution, before charge roll: 1 mode must be selected from:
- Leap to Defend: only enemy units with charge move made this phase and within maximum distance selectable as charge targets
core/stratagems/Heroic Intervention/seco:
Into the Fray
- charge roll: result above 6 after modifiers changed to 6
- charge targets: may select any enemy unit ≤6" of your unit and within the maximum distance
core/stratagems/Heroic Intervention/targ:
Friendly unengaged unit ≤12" of an enemy unit
VEHICLE unit selectable only if also a CHARACTER/WALKER unit
core/stratagems/Insane Bravery/when:
Battle-shock step of your Command phase
Just before you make a battle-shock roll for a friendly unit
core/stratagems/New Orders/effect:
That card discarded
1 new Secondary Mission card drawn
core/stratagems/New Orders/target: Active Secondary Mission card of yours
core/stratagems/Rapid Ingress/restrictio: Not usable during the first battle round
core/stratagems/Rapid Ingress/target:
Friendly unit in Strategic Reserves
AIRCRAFT excluded
core/stratagems/Rapid Ingress/when: End of your opponent's Movement phase
core/stratagems/Smokescreen/effect:
Each time an attack targets own SMOKE unit, or a unit not fully visible to the attacking model because of a model in own SMOKE unit
Target gains the benefit of cover against that attack (13.08)
until end of phase
